name: Family Home Dashboard
role: Each user owns their Home preferences. Shared entries and music remain subject to current library permissions.
config: Per-user preferences or explicit form settings
evidence: 191 guarded local HTTP checks across four acceptance suites; Go and UI regression suites. Production release candidate not deployed.

name: Family Shelves
role: Only the owner edits the shelf. A shared recipient can read allowed content; an administrator does not gain access to another adult’s private shelf.
config: Per-user preferences or explicit form settings
evidence: 191 guarded local HTTP checks across four acceptance suites; Go and UI regression suites. Production release candidate not deployed.

name: Family Music Time Capsule
role: Private by default; explicit recipients and current library access are checked again when reading attachments.
config: Per-user preferences or explicit form settings
evidence: 191 guarded local HTTP checks across four acceptance suites; Go and UI regression suites. Production release candidate not deployed.

name: Music Letters
role: Drafts are private to their author. Scheduled letters are hidden from recipients until delivery. Recipient access and attachment authorization are enforced on the server.
config: Per-user preferences or explicit form settings
evidence: 191 guarded local HTTP checks across four acceptance suites; Go and UI regression suites. Production release candidate not deployed.

name: Family Music Requests
role: Drafts remain private. Submitted requests go to server-derived administrator recipients; regular members cannot perform administrator status transitions.
config: Per-user preferences or explicit form settings
evidence: 191 guarded local HTTP checks across four acceptance suites; Go and UI regression suites. Production release candidate not deployed.

name: Forgotten Albums
role: Suggestions and dismissals are personal and filtered by current library permissions.
config: Per-user preferences or explicit form settings
evidence: 191 guarded local HTTP checks across four acceptance suites; Go and UI regression suites. Production release candidate not deployed.

name: Music Quality Passport
role: Only currently authorized catalog references resolve. Secret source paths, credentials and remote object URLs are not part of the passport.

evidence: 191 guarded local HTTP checks across four acceptance suites; Go and UI regression suites. Production release candidate not deployed.

name: Library Doctor
role: Administrator only. Protected child accounts cannot access diagnostic jobs or diagnostic audio leases.
config: Per-user preferences or explicit form settings
evidence: 191 guarded local HTTP checks across four acceptance suites; Go and UI regression suites. Production release candidate not deployed.

name: Version Collector
role: Catalog permissions are rechecked. Preferences are per user and cannot grant access to an otherwise private library.
config: Per-user preferences or explicit form settings
evidence: 191 guarded local HTTP checks across four acceptance suites; Go and UI regression suites. Production release candidate not deployed.

name: Kids Music World
role: No child account is created automatically. Library access and server route guards apply even when calling APIs directly. Sharing with other adults is off unless explicitly enabled by the parent.
config: Per-user preferences or explicit form settings
evidence: 191 guarded local HTTP checks across four acceptance suites; Go and UI regression suites. Production release candidate not deployed.

name: Family Legacy Export
